assign.title: Sessions: record-only (cloud voice) sessions get a snapshot
assign.outcome:
**Cloud voice sessions now get a day-index snapshot, so the grid and dashboard can list them.**

- [x] snapshot for a record-only folder: `AISessionIndex.record_snap()` + `load_records()` + a watch on `session.jsonl`; test `AISessionIndex.test.mjs` passes
- [x] grid kind chip `cloud voice`: new rule in `AISessionBuckets.js` (without it the row fell into hidden `short-run`)
- [x] dashboard origin: `SessionTree` already maps `cloud-voice*` folders to Voice, so it needs only the snapshot
- [x] readme row added: [sessions readme](/framework/ai/sessions/readme.md)
- [ ] live proof: needs a dev-server restart (the watcher runs inside it), then check `/framework/ai/sessions/` and `/framework/ai/`. I did not restart it. The merge ran with `--skip-smoke` because the worktree had no dev server; I loaded the changed modules in node instead.
